frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Star clusters of M82 that Lim et al. (2013) found in Hubble images: one dot per cluster at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way open-cluster layer's blue-white, size and opacity. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
